complaints_target_present.name: complaints_target_present
complaints_target_present.value: ("complaints"."target_type" = 'USER' AND "complaints"."target_user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("complaints"."target_type" = 'SELLER' AND "complaints"."target_seller_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("complaints"."target_type" = 'PRODUCT' AND "complaints"."target_product_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("complaints"."target_type" = 'ORDER' AND "complaints"."order_id" IS NOT NULL)

conversation_members_identity_xor.name: conversation_members_identity_xor
conversation_members_identity_xor.value: (CASE WHEN "conversation_members"."user_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) + (CASE WHEN "conversation_members"."admin_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) = 1

favorites_target_matches.name: favorites_target_matches
favorites_target_matches.value: ("favorites"."target_type" = 'SELLER' AND "favorites"."seller_id" IS NOT NULL AND "favorites"."product_id" IS NULL) OR ("favorites"."target_type" = 'PRODUCT' AND "favorites"."product_id" IS NOT NULL AND "favorites"."seller_id" IS NULL)

ledger_accounts_owner_matches.name: ledger_accounts_owner_matches
ledger_accounts_owner_matches.value: ("ledger_accounts"."owner_type" = 'SELLER' AND "ledger_accounts"."seller_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ledger_accounts"."system_key" IS NULL) OR ("ledger_accounts"."owner_type" IN ('PLATFORM','CLEARING') AND "ledger_accounts"."seller_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_accounts"."system_key" IS NOT NULL)

messages_sender_valid.name: messages_sender_valid
messages_sender_valid.value: ("messages"."sender_role" = 'SYSTEM' AND "messages"."sender_user_id" IS NULL AND "messages"."sender_admin_id" IS NULL) OR ("messages"."sender_role" = 'ADMIN' AND "messages"."sender_admin_id" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."sender_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("messages"."sender_role" IN ('BUYER','SELLER','USER') AND "messages"."sender_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."sender_admin_id" IS NULL)

rating_aggregates_target_matches.name: rating_aggregates_target_matches
rating_aggregates_target_matches.value: ("rating_aggregates"."subject_type" = 'SELLER' AND "rating_aggregates"."seller_id" IS NOT NULL AND "rating_aggregates"."product_id" IS NULL) OR ("rating_aggregates"."subject_type" = 'PRODUCT' AND "rating_aggregates"."product_id" IS NOT NULL AND "rating_aggregates"."seller_id" IS NULL)
